description: Draw a print-ready dieline at an exact size in the signed-in person's Drint space and return a download link (valid one hour): PDF / AI (cut and crease as spot colours with dimensions, opens in Illustrator) or SVG (CUT / CREASE layers). Give a standard code (FEFCO "0201", "0427"; ECMA "A20.20.03.01", "A60.20.00.01") or a Drint type id from list_dielines. Length, width, height are the inside size in mm. The Free plan has 3 of these a month, Pro unlimited. For the die-maker's DXF or CF2 files use make_dieline.

code.description: A FEFCO or ECMA code, e.g. "0201", "FEFCO 0427", "A20.20.03.01". Give this or type.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

name.description: A short file name, e.g. the product. Optional.

type.description: A Drint type id from list_dielines, e.g. "rte", "bag", "pillow". Give this or code.

name: get_dieline
title: Get a dieline
